_comment: Grouping and icons for the Pathways view. Lives in data, not in app.js, for the same reason county names do: these are editorial choices the project lead should be able to change without touching code. The 20 schema categories collapse into 9 plain-language groups per CLAUDE.md's tone rule — 'Help learning to get around safely' beats 'Orientation & Mobility Services'. The schema's `housing` category is deliberately absent: no record uses it, and an empty district would imply we have housing services when we have none.

county_map._comment: A schematic cartogram, NOT a projection. Twelve tiles on a small grid, arranged to approximate relative position with Mecklenburg central. Deliberately not real boundaries: real polygons would be a large committed asset, would need a source, and would be illegible at 150% text. The caption on the page says it is schematic so nobody reads it as a real map. Columns and rows are grid cells, origin top-left.
county_map.caption: Schematic — relative position, not to scale, and not a real map.

_match_note: Records carry several categories, so a record is filed under the group with the LOWEST match_priority it matches, not the first in display order. Without this, the 17 records tagged veterans mostly also carry a rehabilitation category and would file under 'Learning to live with sight loss', leaving a veteran who opens the Veterans group to find almost nothing.
